# CYD (ESP32-2432S028) 4 MB partition table — single app slot.
# Name
# This exists ONLY to fit the Sunton ESP32-2432S028 "Cheap Yellow Display"
# which has 4 MB of flash. The stock partitions.csv ends at 4.13 MB (two 2 MB
# OTA slots then prod_data/prod_bak at fixed offsets)
# WHAT IS LOST vs the reference layout:
#   - No ota_1: there is exactly ONE app slot
#     Dual-OTA and automatic rollback are gone. OTA updates are also off by
#     default on non-UI builds
so in practice this board is flash-over-USB only.

# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms: #   - prod_data/prod_bak are dropped entirely. They are written during
#     manufacturing and Muse never writes them on a hobby board
#     may expect the `prod_data` partition handle to exist; if it probes for
#     them at boot
# Because there is no ota_0/ota_1 pair
the app runs as `factory` and must be

# Copyright (c) Meta Platforms: # built with OTA disabled (CONFIG_HOMEHUB_OTA_ENABLED=n
# for non-UI boards).
# Offsets: nvs/otadata/phy_init keep the reference values (0x11000
# 0x19000) so they sit after the enlarged bootloader at the 0x10000 table
# offset. The app starts at 0x20000 to stay 8 KB-aligned and clear of phy_init.
# Space available to the app: 0x3E0000 = 3.875 MB.
nvs
otadata
phy_init
factory
